 Trending McDonald’s Launches ‘Home Alone’ Meal Inspired by Kevin’s Cravings
 Macaulay Culkin, who played Kevin McCallister, is starring in an ad campaign for the fast-food chain. Nov. 17, 2026, 8:00 AM EST / Source : TODAY Joseph Lamour
 McDonald's is launching the "Home Alone" meal 36 years after the movie premiered. McDonald's Share Add TODAY to Google This yuletide season, McDonald’s is offering the gift of nostalgia.
 Thirty-six years after the debut of the classic holiday movie, the burger behemoth announced the “Home Alone” Meal, with limited-time menu items and collectible socks, as well as in-person and virtual experiences. The Disney partnership meal will be available at participating restaurants nationwide starting Dec. 1, while supplies last.
 McDonald’s has turned some of Kevin McCallister’s (Macaulay Culkin) most memorable movie moments into a trio of menu items:
 Medium Little Nero’s Pizza McShaker Fries are inspired by the rambunctious kid’s go-to pizza (plain cheese), with McShaker seasoning (notes of tomato, garlic, Italian herbs and cheese) that you can add with a McShaker bag.
 Little Nero's Pizza McShaker Fries Courtesy McDonald's Lovely Cheese Pizza Dipping Sauce , also inspired by McCallister’s preferred pizza, combines tomato flavor, Parmesan cheese, garden herbs and a hint of garlic. You get this sauce with the choice of Chicken McNuggets or McCrispy Strips, or you can just order it a la carte.
 Lovely Cheese Pizza Dipping Sauce Courtesy McDonald's Everything Sundae McFlurry features vanilla soft-serve swirled with hot fudge, Oreo cookie pieces and M&M’s, channeling Kevin’s room-service feast in “Home Alone 2: Lost in New York.”
 Everything Sundae McFlurry Courtesy McDonald's Customers can collect one of four sock designs with their meal, including one inspired by the film’s most culturally enduring moment: Kevin’s scream . The other three socks feature Grimace, Birdy and the Hamburglar, who might’ve joined the Wet Bandits if they only stole Big Macs.
 McDonald's "Home Alone" Meal Collectible Socks. Courtesy McDonald's “Home Alone” came out 36 years ago, on Nov. 10, 1990. Culkin, who may have a reboot in the works , is starring an ad campaign for the partnership in which he enjoys time alone in an empty McDonald’s.
 “What I love about this collaboration is that the Home Alone Meal captures something bigger than just one character, it’s about the playful spirit that resonates with people across generations,” Culkin said in a press release. “Bringing this to life with McDonald’s and getting to reexperience these moments with my own kids, reminds me why fans keep coming back to Kevin’s story. That’s the magic we’re celebrating here.”
 McDonald's is launching the "Home Alone" Meal 36 years after the movie debuted. McDonald's On Dec. 4 through Dec. 5 from 5 — 10 p.m. PT, the McDonald’s Home Alone Challenge, an immersive pop-up experience in Los Angeles, California, will let fans complete a series of challenges in themed, interactive rooms, like sliding into a ball pit or testing out your slingshot skills, for a free “Home Alone” Meal. 
 You can register for the experience here .
 In the McDonald’s app, customers can redeem $5 off a $20 McDelivery order or use MyMcDonald’s Rewards points to redeem a 14-day free trial of the Disney+Hulu bundle, where they can access the “Home Alone” collection.
 Customers also have the ability to round up their order cost to help Ronald McDonald House families stay together during a child’s medical journey.
 Last year, McDonald’s partnered with another iconic Christmas movie, “The Grinch,” to launch a meal featuring Dill Pickle “Grinch Salt” McShaker Fries.
